published_title: Maul Craziness II: The Bane of Maul
description: An update to one of my favorite decks.
strategy:
Well, I've been planning on updating this deck since Animalvader gave me a real good tip, and the release of Bane Malar (V), a much improved Rodian (V) just made me want to whip this deck up.

First off, pull If The Trace Was Correct. Hopefully you will have a Maul. The first site you should pull should be the Cantina if you have an Expand the Empire or you were given enough force to let you use a Twi'lek (if you got it) to pull it. Drop EXE on the Landing Site and drop your free Maul to the Cantina. If this doesn't happen, just set up Maul at the Site and go for the extra activation of Jabba's Palace.

By Expanding the Landing Site's text, you will be able to get a drain of SIX at the Cantina, even if Amidala is out. Your major focus is Maul's drains. Go after the opponent. Especially if Resistance is out (which a smart opponent will do). Be sure to get Bane out to protect your uber drains.

The drains will put a lot of pressure on your opponent. If the Landing Site gets seperated from the Cantina (say against WYS or someone playing DB 94), set up elsewhere. You still get nasty drains.

Like I said, Resistance kills your drains. Your only hope is to kick them off three battlegrounds. I wanted to include some SAC, but I was having some trouble to include. Any suggestions would be wonderful, as well as any other constructive critiscm.
